description.text:
A top-four deck of the Masters Division at the 2024 World Championships, built around Miraidon ex. Its Tandem Unit Ability puts Lightning Pokémon from the deck onto the Bench, Electric Generator attaches Energy to them from the top of the deck, and Iron Hands ex and Raikou V back it up. The 2024 World Championships were held at the Hawai'i Convention Center in Honolulu from 16 to 18 August 2024, back in Hawaii for the first time since 2012.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2024 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a pin, a coin, a deck box, a playmat, a poster and a code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
